Text: Central Bank Retirees' Association (Karnataka) (Affiliated to AICBRF/AIBRF)  General Secretary's Report Dear Members, It gives me great pleasure to invite you all to the Annual General Body Meeting of our Association, Central Bank Retirees' Association (Karnataka), on Thursday, 2 July 2026. On behalf of our Managing Committee and on my own behalf, I warmly welcome you all with due respect and affection. The banking industry in general, and our Bank in particular, has undergone many changes. Sri M. V. Rao has relinquished his office as CMD & CEO, and Sri Kalyan Kumar has assumed charge as the CMD & CEO of our Bank. Our Bank continues to improve its business year after year and has received

improve its business year after year and has received several prestigious awards during the year, including the SKOTCH Award and the Best Technology Bank Award. Our Association has more than 500 members as of 30/06/2026. We are updating the membership register to facilitate better communication. Our Managing Committee continues to assist members with HRMS, health insurance, and other matters. We also have a dedicated team of volunteers who are always ready to support our members. Today is a special occasion, as it provides an opportunity for our members to meet friends and colleagues with whom they spent a significant part of their professional lives. The welfare of our members and their

professional lives. The welfare of our members and their families remains our highest priority, and we seek your wholehearted cooperation and the blessings of the Almighty. In keeping with our tradition, the day began with Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Pooja for the well-being of our members and their families. Throughout the year, we conducted several virtual meetings to discuss developments in the banking industry and address the needs of our members. We enjoyed excellent cooperation from both the Bangalore and Hubballi Regional Offices. Sri Parthasarathy Naidu Ji and Sri Dodda Rangappa Ji have been extremely supportive. Even after his promotion and transfer to the Central Office as General

promotion and transfer to the Central Office as General Manager, Sri Parthasarathy Naidu Ji has continued to assist our members by taking up our issues with various departments. Our office bearers and members in Hubballi have also been serving members diligently, and Sri Dodda Rangappa Ji has been highly cooperative. We also welcome our present Regional Head, Sri Satish Babu Ji, who is our Chief Guest today, and look forward to his continued support during his tenure.

Our Association, though functioning successfully for several years, is yet to be registered with the Department of Co-operative Societies, Government of Karnataka. A core committee has been formed, and the registration process is now in its final stage. During the year, 24 new members joined our Association. We extend a warm welcome to them. The list of new members is enclosed with this report. I request all members to encourage other retirees to become members of our Association. We are deeply saddened by the loss of 15 members of our Association during the year. We extend our heartfelt condolences to their families and assure them of our continued support. As part of our tradition, we are

continued support. As part of our tradition, we are honouring members who completed 70 years of age as of 30/06/2026. The list of eligible members for the period from 01/07/2025 to 30/06/2026 is enclosed. Members are requested to inform us if any names have been omitted so they may be included. Our Bank continues to operate the Sir Sorabjee Pochkhanwala Memorial Death Relief Scheme for pensioners. Pensioners and family pensioners who have not yet enrolled are requested to join at the earliest. Our members actively participate in social and environmental initiatives under the guidance of our Chief Patron, Sri B. N. S. Ratnakar. On 27 June 2026, members participated in the Adamya Chetana Megha

2026, members participated in the Adamya Chetana Megha Tree Plantation Drive, sponsored by the Bangalore Development Authority, and planted many trees at Banashankari 6th Stage, Bangalore. Earlier, some members also participated in a tree plantation programme at Tumkur University on 14/12/2025, where about 1,000 trees were planted. We are informed that an impressive 99% survival rate has been achieved through dedicated maintenance by the University authorities. We are proud of our members' commitment and encourage everyone to participate in such initiatives for the benefit of future generations and to preserve the ecological balance. organised a meeting for Hubballi Region members at Hotel Swathy on 24/02/2026. The meeting was well attended and addressed by our Regional Head, Sri Dodda Rangappa Ji. We have a dedicated team of office bearers in Hubballi, and we plan to hold similar meetings in Mysore, Mangalore, and other cities across Karnataka. All pensioners are eagerly awaiting pension updation. The M. C. Singla case is listed for hearing on 22 July, and we hope for a favourable outcome. The GST case before the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala has been adjourned to 01/07/2026, and we await its outcome. Our apex Association, AICBRF, held a joint discussion with our Management on 18/06/2026. The detailed circular was shared

Management on 18/06/2026. The detailed circular was shared with members on the same day. As in previous years, some of our members participated in the TCS Bangalore Marathon under the Senior Citizens' Walkathon in April 2026.

On behalf of our Association, several office bearers and committee members attended meetings organised by AIBRF (Karnataka) and AICBRF during the year. Our Organising Secretary, Smt. S. R. Meera, has been selected to serve on one of their committees. We also recently visited our senior member and former General Secretary of the Working Employees' Union, Sri M. V. V. Murthy, to enquire about his health and ongoing activities. He was delighted to receive our members. Our members are our greatest strength and a constant source of inspiration. I request everyone to remain connected, support one another, and continue to nurture the friendships we have built over the years. We assure all our

friendships we have built over the years. We assure all our members that we will continue to support them and their families and work tirelessly for their welfare. I sincerely thank the Managing Committee for their wholehearted support in carrying out the activities of our Association. I also thank the family of Late Sri G. Subbaraya Setty for allowing us to hold our meeting in the hall.  G. N. Umamaheshwar General Secretary CBRA (Karnataka)
